notes.title: Rainy City: Pandemic is part of Earth Appreciation Day & new update!
notes.notes:
We're very proud to announce that Rainy City: Pandemic is part of Steam's Earth Appreciation Day this year, and is discounted for the event as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37757871/0b993b4fcbe7717fb8b7179ede9f310de788a017.jpg[/img]

It's a really cool event showcasing games about when nature goes right with amazing gardening games and gratifying gardening games- and when nature goes wrong with a post-apocalyptic games like Rainy City: Pandemic!

You're a pizza delivery person and your sister is becoming sick in this cyberpunk dystopian tale set in the near future where the pandemic was never eradicated.  Made deliveries, meet the locals, answer to your demanding boss and try and raise enough money to save your sister in time!

We've also changed a few things in the latest update to the game:

- Added a note about the game's development.  We made Rainy City: Pandemic in Summer/Fall 2020, based on our experiences in Spring 2020.  We hope that helps put the game in context going forward into the future, since some of our predictions have turned out right and some turned out wrong.
- Added credits to title screen
- Adjusted the hover car's turn sensitivity and added a setting for it in the menu
- Lengthened the day length in normal mode to allow for more time
- Fixed a few spelling errors and some words being missing.
- This update is for the PC version, we hope to have the Mac update out soon.

Thanks for checking out the game and good luck in Rainy City!

notes.title: Big Update! Mac Version, New Stories & Game Logic Re-work!
notes.notes:
You asked, we listened!  We changed up a number of things in the game- we're super in love with this new version and we hope you check out the update.  There's a lot of new stuff to explore even if you've already played through!

Now, the details!

-Mac version
The game is now available on Mac!  A PC/Mac release was our original intent so we're super pleased to offer the Mac version of the game.

-Updated stories
Betty has a heck of a lot more to say now- about pizza making, her shop, and more (could she have a secret love interest??).  She says something new every time you talk to her- sometimes silly, sometimes serious- but she has been updated to be one chatty character with a lot of history!
We've also gone much more in-depth on the conversations for all the customers- you learn a lot more about their lives and backstories, and we re-wrote some of their personalities and interests.  Randy is my favorite turnaround- I disliked him quite a bit at the start, and now he's one of my favorite characters.

-Conversations
We've also added in some fun new multiple choice conversations- it's not just all about the characters anymore, now you can add your input to the conversation!

-Delivery Logic System Rework
We were finding players would get repeats of the same characters, and not get to see some of the other characters at all (Tragic!  Everyone must meet Lucy!).  So we changed up the delivery algorithm so players get to talk to every character in the game- although you may have to beat the game on hard mode to hear the end to everyone's stories!

-Ending
We made the winning end sequence a little smoother.  We can't really say how or we'll spoil it!  But, it's quite nice now.

-Difficulty
Through a long series of decisions we decided to remove Easy mode- the new delivery logic will allow you to play on Normal without too much stress.  We also locked up Hard mode- you have to beat the game on Normal first!

-Bug fixes
Always bug fixes.  Some typo fixes as well.
